description: CAT-Q, SQL re-rendering over a wider set than r-cat-1/querydefs. Sixteen saved queries are created with CreateQueryDef(name, sql) from deliberately irregular text (lower-case keywords, extra spaces, tabs, CR/LF, qualified names, ON with AND, TOP PERCENT, DISTINCT/DISTINCTROW, GROUP BY/HAVING, IN (subquery), IIf with brackets and aliases, three-arm UNION, UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT...SELECT, TRANSFORM/PIVOT, quoted strings with a semicolon and an apostrophe). Each SQL is read on the creating handle, then the database is closed and reopened read/write and every query's SQL and Type are read from the refreshed QueryDefs. Asks which re-rendering rules apply on save and reopen.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, A TEXT(20), B LONG)
CREATE TABLE U (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_U PRIMARY KEY, X LONG, A TEXT(20))
select  t.id ,t.a   from   t  where  t.b>5 and t.a='x;y'  order by t.id desc,t.a
SELECT TOP 2 PERCENT ID FROM T
SELECT T.ID, U.X FROM T INNER JOIN U ON T.ID = U.ID AND T.A = U.A
SELECT A, COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(B) AS S FROM T GROUP BY A HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY A
SELECT ID FROM T WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM U WHERE X > (1 + 2) * 3)
SELECT IIf(B > 1, 'a', 'b') AS C, [A] AS [My Col] FROM T
SELECT ID FROM T UNION SELECT ID FROM U UNION ALL SELECT X FROM U
SELECT T.* FROM T LEFT JOIN U ON T.ID = U.ID WHERE U.ID IS NULL
UPDATE T SET B = B + 1 WHERE A LIKE 'a*'
DELETE FROM T WHERE ID BETWEEN 1 AND 2
INSERT INTO U (ID, X) SELECT ID, B FROM T
TRANSFORM Sum(B) AS SB SELECT A FROM T GROUP BY A PIVOT ID IN (1, 2)
